segments.sn20.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn20.10:1.5: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno na viramati.
segments.sn20.10:1.6: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn20.10:1.7: “idha, bhante, aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn20.10:1.10: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno na viramatī”ti.
segments.sn20.10:2.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, biḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre ṭhito ahosi mudumūsiṃ maggayamāno –
segments.sn20.10:2.2: ‘yadāyaṃ mudumūsi gocarāya pakkamissati, tattheva naṃ gahetvā khādissāmī’ti.
segments.sn20.10:2.3: Atha kho so, bhikkhave, mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi.
segments.sn20.10:2.4: Tamenaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā saṅkhāditvā [saṅkharitvā (pī. ka.), maṃsaṃ khāditvā (syā. kaṃ.), asaṃkhāditvā (katthaci)] ajjhohari.
segments.sn20.10:2.5: Tassa so mudumūsi antampi khādi, antaguṇampi khādi.
segments.sn20.10:2.6: So tatonidānaṃ maraṇampi nigacchi maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn20.10:3.1: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena, anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā, asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
segments.sn20.10:3.2: So tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā.
segments.sn20.10:3.3: Tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
segments.sn20.10:3.4: So rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigacchati maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn20.10:3.5: Maraṇañhetaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
segments.sn20.10:3.6: Maraṇamattañhetaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn20.10:3.9: ‘rakkhiteneva kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena, upaṭṭhitāya satiyā, saṃvutehi indriyehi gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā’ti.

lines: Dasame sandhisamalasaṃkaṭīreti ettha sandhīti bhinnagharānaṃ sandhi, samaloti gāmato gūthanikkhamanamaggo, saṃkaṭīranti saṅkāraṭṭhānaṃ.
Vuṭṭhānanti āpannaāpattito, na kilesato vuṭṭhānaṃ, suddhante adhiṭṭhānaṃ.
Taṃ pana yathāāpannāya āpattiyā “desanā”tveva vuccatīti āha “desanā paññāyatī”ti.
